entries.text: I pray in Jesus' name, glory to Lord of hosts and our Lord Almighty, from Whom all blessings flow. Amen🙏✝️

I am getting a number of scriptures telling me that something might go down today... like at the end of John 11, people seek out Jesus to arrest him, how Phillipians 1, talks about us being ready to be persecuted for his namesake... and Psalm 36, talks about the wicked doing wrong once again... 

However I will not fear, also in the John chapter, despite the risk of Jesus being arrested and executed when he goes back to revive Lazarus, Jesus says those who walk in the light, wont stumble... this is talking about us walking in him, following the Lord, and he will not let us stumble, and so like Thomas I say... "Let us die with him", additionally I know he's covering me under the shadows of his wings, for hes over me... both my steps, and the sky above me are covered... and even if... even if I am to be persecuted, its for the greater glory of his kingdom... so I have no fear to go out and proclaim the Gospel today... even if I am killed or arrested... I will overcome, through Christ Jesus... so take heart brothers and sisters, walk in the Lord, and no matter what happens, we shall overcome this world!!!

https://bible.com/videos/54896?utm=video&language_tag=en

Who are you thankful for today?

That she is not only protected from the enemy, but from witchcraft, Idolotry, and that the strong man inside of her be awakened, that it convict, and it destroy anything and everything that might be blocking her heart

General prayers for our sister in Christ Christina!!! 

#Jesus4Christina

Wait grandma or pa, or is it literally both?
Please keep praying for my family y’all. I spoke about Jesus and the gospel to my sister and she completely rejected it, so I just pray that a seed was planted..
Also pray that I get my credit card thing figured out because I’m realizing it’s more difficult to figure out and get set up

Hey update on Granny's health she got better, Praise God, additionally prayer for Annette (my aunt) and her daughter (my cousin) that they can just continue to walk in Christ amd stay close to him, that they can walk in the spirit, and they may be protected from whatever issues they have in their life

Hey, I am getting vibes that something big might happen in the near future, that there will be a temptation that I will have to endure that if I fail, will impact my life long term, like how Davids, sickness allowed the rebellion from his son


However God has given me an out, prayer, I need to pray, and pray without ceasing, as I approach the end of John, I am realizing its almost matching up with my plans on Friday, thats actually when Peter will deny Jesus if I continue my plan, and so I am becoming painfully aware that something will happen then, my request and prayer, is that you intercede for me, and do it as often as you can, not just once, but again and again, and again... that I may be protected against the enemy, anxiety, depression, fear... that I may seek and obey Gods will, rather then my own... I don't want to sin, but I also know as my verse of the day shows, in that same chapter, there are sins, I may commit I have no awareness of, and so I need protection and forgiveness for those sins, but also that they may be revealed to me so I can repent... I am trying my absolute best to be faithful to God, so please help me... and I will pray and do my own part... additionally if temptation comes, I know God will provide a way out, so please keep encouraging me to walk the good walk, however, as Jesus instructed Peter back in gethsemene, he said pray without ceasing, and he tried to shelter Peter from his sin, in advance, to build up his spiritual walls... I ask you all help me. 

Let my words, my prayers, be sufficient for God, but even more so, let our words, I know its written when two or more agree on something it will be done for them in Jesus's name...

So I ask all this in Jesus's name, and I pray... Amen 😞🙏

Please pray for my heart. That I would not loose hope, that I would not allow the enemy to get in my head with lies and discouragement. I also need guidance from the Lord.. I want to know what to do next.. I just want peace, unity.. I rebuke rejection, I rebuke manipulation, I rebuke unkindness, I rebuke impatience, pride and arrogance. We’re children of God, let’s act like it. God doesn’t promise tomorrow, let’s start acting like today is our last chance to show the love of God.

Be still and know that I am God... right now I am struggling, actually I am having such bad mental and emotional reactions I am still awake, I am having physiological issues too, right now a storm is surrounding me, and the army of darkness encamps against me

However the lord is my fortress, my stronghold, my help in this time of trouble... and nothing, nobody, can remove him from me... so I shall not fear, even if the actual biological signs are almost like I am in the fight of my life... I can rest knowing I am safe with you... I shall not be afaid.... I shall be still and know... my God is God... that the storm thats tossing me around will end, and I shall rejoice when it comes, and I shall sing and clap my hands... I shall praise you again! I will hold on, and wait...  show me what you can do, I believe in you!
I'm praying for you Liam

Btw also say a prayer for me, as me and my camp treasurer Stephen O'Brien are preparing to make our trip to Vlad Savchuk's Hungry Gen church I got nightmares tonight that I awoke from and it's demons who are threatening me and my family with murder

I rebuke any and all evil spirits in the mighty Name of Jesus and ask you all to all pray for me as this is a very specific and targeted attack

Praying for everyone in this ministry likewise and your personal families, selves, and friends

Prayer Request from India 9/28/2026:

"Good morning David 

I'm sorry to disturb you like this, at this hour but I've been going through a rough patch recently. 

Financing my brother's college fees and tuition is draining all of my savings. Even him helping me by getting a job is only keeping us afloat with no savings at all. I fear, I may run out of savings, if this continues. 

God has always rescued me in such times and protected me by giving me a shelter. Giving my existing job and blessings me. 

All I can do is pray right now and I would appreciate your prayers too. I know you and the others are people of faith and that you pray for those who come to you seeking God's guidance and blessings. 

That's why I felt comfortable reaching out to you. Again thank you for taking the time to read this, God bless you."

Prayer Request for Woodway Young Adults 10/1/2026:

For some of you that do not know, I record content for our ministry for our scripture reading and I came to this park in woodway, WA where I was planning to film one of the scriptures that we are covering. There is five young adults or teenagers that were sitting at a table cursing and just talking nonsense. So the Holy Spirit prompted me to come up to them and on the third try of the Holy Spirit nudging me. I finally gave in and grabbed some Bibles and I walked up to them and asked them if they go to church to which they said why do I care?

One of the girls told me straight up that she does not care and after questioning her where her salvation is, the entire group decided it was better to leave than interact with me. Please keep young adults in your prayers so that we could see Revival happening in this state because it starts with the youth and if we do not pray, God will not be able to prepare the soil.
#JESUS4HAYDEN
